dataset.name: GIST1M
dataset.snapshot: same immutable snapshot as Gate0;self-matches retained

decision.B8: Exploratory,does not block B2/B4;no all-B generalization
decision.Gate2: Only after complete Gate1 GO;separately test reusable physical compatibility across queries,batches,seeds,datasets and net lookup/repair/update cost;no automatic index or GPU admission
all_conditions_for_each_of_B2_B4: sum(candidate full source)<sum(batch full scan source)
no heldout-informed design/selection or altered membership/radius
decision.heldout_gain_disappears: Close BQSI direction for this mechanism,retain negative evidence and exact scope
priority: both B2 and B4 meet every declared condition -> SOURCE_MODEL_GATE1_GO

disclosure: This is an input/protocol freeze and development reproducibility checkpoint,not completion of Gate1,novelty proof,independent-dataset validation,or measured GPU speedup.

fixed_physics.full_scan: 3,840,000,000+3960*B source bytes per batch,one original-order scan,no duplicate terminal
fixed_physics.layout: Hypothetical single coordinate-major FP32 representation;conversion unmeasured
fixed_physics.metadata: Candidate read-only scheduler metadata input bytes are charged once per batch in full source cost;any reread from source also charged.No oracle/context/depth file is scheduler input. Dynamic state bytes,peak live storage,read/write counts and CPU time reported separately,not called actual DRAM.
fixed_physics.output_cost: No real query output generation in Gate1A;later exact verifier must agree fully;source model is not end-to-end latency
fixed_physics.per_query_order: Inherited PDX top3/30 zone order,unchanged arithmetic and guarded exact verifier;query-specific order derivation is not performed in Gate1A
fixed_physics.terminal: Finish B filter chains within one8-row sector,then original-order960dim verification for union of depth30 sectors,including conservative last-zone nonhits;no free filter/terminal retention

allowed: fixed batch IDs and input queries/radii
currently ready tile identities and query membership
past emitted reads,partial sums,rejections,and finished flags revealed only after execution
bounded query-local age/history derived from past execution
information_boundary.execution_boundary: Scheduler receives a ready-only provider;trace storage/oracle process is outside scheduler capability.No depth-key context aggregation for online execution;all125000 sectors per batch must be stepped.
forbidden: future rejection depth or true chain length
cache or planner prefetch of a not-ready query operation
information_boundary.noninterference_test: Before implementation freeze,use synthetic pairs identical through the current frontier but different future depths:decisions must agree until provider histories differ.

one_shot.Gate1A_allowed: identity-only query extraction;old32 trace replay;no heldout distances,PDX order,depths,oracle or scheduler results
one_shot.Gate1A_replay_script: Only Gate1A subcommands exist;there is no heldout evaluation command
Gate1B_required_before_heldout: primary candidate selection and signed-off bounded execution registration
one_shot.Gate1C: One heldout evaluation after all preconditions;exclusive start ticket before any heldout feature/trace derivation;first failure stops,no automatic retries or tuning
one_shot.failure_retention: Keep start,failures,partial outputs and frozen inputs.Any authorized recovery is separately recorded and cannot change semantics or erase failed samples.

oracle.B8: Exploratory UNRESOLVED unless certified exact;no B8-targeted candidate tuning or extra oracle budget in this protocol
oracle.family: Minimum tile-read schedule interleaving fixed per-query zone chains,one sector at a time;every emitted symbol serves all currently ready matching queries;no changing orders,no prefetch,one1024B tile buffer
oracle.method: A* with union-of-remaining-symbol lower bound and initial pairwise exact SCS lower bound;feasible upper=min fixed simple witnesses
oracle.order: Run diagnostic oracle only after candidate outputs are sealed;never expose it to design or scheduler
oracle.scope: Fixed-chain finite source-model optimum,not an information-theoretic lower bound or a realizable scheduler

radii.distribution: Empirical parent distribution is a point mass:all32 use the same radius;all128 independent draws from this point mass are identical
radii.new_radius_rule: Any non-degenerate radius experiment requires a separate pre-outcome protocol;do not replace this cohort or this test
radii.radius_rng: Not applicable:degenerate distribution;no fabricated multiradius study or radius selection by sharing opportunity

sampling.batch_rule: Sort query indices by (SHA256(ASCII BQSI-G1A-batch:{batch_seed}:{qid}) bytes,index);consecutive disjoint chunks separately for B2/B4/B8;identical membership for every strategy
sampling.duplicates: After identity freeze,byte-identical vector to development or within heldout stops Gate1A;never redraw based on coordinates or outcomes
sampling.population_scope: Heldout identities versus original32 only;same database-derived query population,not an independent dataset or production arrival trace;not a claim of exclusion from every earlier project experiment
sampling.query_rule: For counter=0,1,... SHA256(ASCII BQSI-G1A-query:{query_seed}:{counter});big-endian uint256;reject values>=floor(2^256/N)*N,otherwise value mod N;skip development IDs and repeated IDs until128 accepted;no geometry or outcome access

scope: CPU-only future-blind fixed-batch source-cost test;BQSI remains a hypothesis;no index,CUDA,service SLA or manuscript admission

bootstrap.interval: two-sided percentile95%;linear interpolation at0.025/0.975 of sorted replicate savings
bootstrap.resample: Python Random(seed).randrange(batch_count),batch_count draws with replacement per replicate;paired costs;one primary candidate only

statistics.gap_capture: delta=sum(F)-sum(C);O in[sum(L),sum(U)];if delta>=0 and sum(F)>sum(L),conservative lower=delta/(sum(F)-sum(L));if sum(F)>sum(U),upper=delta/(sum(F)-sum(U));otherwise upper unavailable.Negative delta is failure;zero/negative residual is not silently passed.
required_metrics: full source bytes/query and filter/terminal/input/metadata breakdown
every batch cost and paired win rate
median relative saving and worst batch loss
metadata input bytes,peak scheduler state,state read/write counts,tile buffer bytes
order construction,scheduler,cost-checker CPU seconds reported separately;not GPU latency
statistics.unit: Paired whole batch within B;report B2,B4,B8 separately,no pooled winner

strategies.baseline: FANOUT_ONLINE:maximum current ready fanout,zone ID ascending ties,eagerly serves all ready matching queries

candidate_status.LAZY_PLAN_DAG: DESIGN_ONLY;planning cannot see unexecuted rejection outcomes;aging/state/parameters must be frozen on development32
candidate_status.PREFIX_REJOIN: NOT_A_DISTINCT_CANDIDATE_YET:FANOUT already rejoins current ready tiles;must supply a non-alias ready-selection or split mechanism,or drop it

strategies.development_only: Original32 only;no heldout vectors,signatures,orders,depths or score inspection for design
strategies.heldout_controls: Port existing controls without exposing future lengths to decision code;GREEDY_LOOKAHEAD may consult known original order,not future depths
strategies.primary_selection: Select one distinct candidate on development32 before heldout;record selection rule,all rejected designs,and hashes in IMPLEMENTATION_FREEZE.json.No choosing winner on heldout.
